Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the senior management of 
company will be meeting with one of the investor/analyst as per below details: 
 
Date & Time 
Type of interaction 
Mode of interaction/meeting 
September 28, 2026  
at 12:30 PM 
One to One Meeting 
Physical

The same is also being uploaded on the Company website i.e. www.hegltd.com  
 
We request you to kindly take the same on record. 
 
Yours truly, 
For HEG Advanced Materials Limited
